restaurants.name: Totot Traditional Restaurant (ጦጦት)
restaurants.description: Addis Ababa’s most renowned destination for authentic Gurage Kitfo prepared with spiced herbal niter kibbeh, fresh kocho, and homemade ayib.
restaurants.promo_badge: Free Fresh Kocho & Ayib with Kitfo Platter Orders!

restaurants.name: Kategna Restaurant (ካትኛ)
restaurants.cuisine: Authentic Habesha, Derek Tibs & Shiro Tegabino
restaurants.description: Beloved multi-award winning Ethiopian restaurant known for sizzling clay-dish tibs, clay-pot shiro tegabino, and hospitable service.
restaurants.promo_badge: Complimentary Kategna Appetizer with Every Main Order!

restaurants.name: Yod Abyssinia Cultural Restaurant (ዮድ አቢሲኒያ)
restaurants.cuisine: Royal Habesha Feasts, Doro Wat & Mahberawi
restaurants.description: Addis Ababa’s premier cultural dining landmark. Serving heritage recipes, rich Doro Wat simmered for hours, and grand festive platters.
restaurants.promo_badge: Special Mahberawi Feast Platter for Family & Groups

restaurants.name: Effoi Pizza (እፎይ ፒዛ)
restaurants.description: Pioneering Addis Ababa’s gourmet pizza scene with stone-oven crusts, rosemary seasoned steak cuts, local herbs, and fresh mozzarella.
restaurants.promo_badge: Buy 2 Large Pizzas Get 1 Free Coca-Cola or Mirinda!

restaurants.name: Moyos Burger (ሞዮስ በርገር)
restaurants.description: Famous local gourmet burger house crafting smashed 100% prime beef patties, melted cheddar, brioche buns, and house secret sauces.
restaurants.promo_badge: Special Combo: Double Burger + Loaded Fries + Soda

restaurants.name: Ristorante Castelli (ካስቴሊ)
restaurants.description: Historic fine-dining Italian restaurant in Piazza operating since 1948. Renowned for handmade ravioli, rich beef lasagna, and tiramisu.
restaurants.promo_badge: Authentic Handcrafted Pasta from Historic Piazza

restaurants.name: Bait Al Mandi (ቤት አል መንዲ)
restaurants.description: Addis Ababa’s most popular spot for fragrant spiced Basmati rice, fall-off-the-bone tender roasted lamb mandi, and hot Yemeni soups.
restaurants.promo_badge: Served with Hot Spicy Sahawiq Salsa & Maraq Soup

foods.name: Special Gurage Kitfo with Kocho & Ayib
foods.description: በተነጠረ አንጓች የሀበሻ ቅቤ፣ ሚጥሚጣና ኮረሪማ የተዘጋጀ ለስላሳ የበሬ ቀይ ስጋ፤ ከትኩስ ቆጮ፣ አይብ እና ጎመን ጋር በሞቀ እንጀራ ይቀርባል።

foods.name: Totot Sizzling Clay-Pot Tibs
foods.description: በትኩስ ሸክላ ላይ በከሰል የሚንሾከሾክ ምርጥ የበሬ ስጋ በሽንኩርት፣ ቃሪያ እና ሮዝመሪ፤ ከልዩ አዋዜና ሰናፍጭ ጋር።

foods.name: Kategna Special Derek Tibs
foods.amharic_name: ካትኛ ልዩ ደረቅ ጥብስ ከሰናፍጭ ጋር
foods.description: በከፍተኛ ሙቀት የተጠበሰ ጥርት ያለ ለስላሳ የበሬ ስጋ በሽንኩርት እና በቃሪያ፤ ከአዋዜና ከተፈጨ ሰናፍጭ ጋር በሞቀ እንጀራ።

foods.name: Royal Kategna Fasting Beyaynetu
foods.description: ምስር ወጥ፣ ሽሮ ፈሰስ፣ አተር ክክ፣ ድንች በካሮት፣ የጎመን ክክ፣ ቀይ ስር፣ ቲማቲም ፍትፍት፣ አዝፋና ሰላጣ በንጹህ የጤፍ እንጀራ ላይ።

foods.name: Royal Doro Wat with Boiled Egg & Ayib
foods.amharic_name: ልዩ የሀገር ቤት ዶሮ ወጥ (ከእንቁላል እና አይብ ጋር)
foods.description: በደከመ ቀይ የበርበሬ ቁሊትና ቅቤ ለሰዓታት የበሰለ የሀበሻ ዶሮ ወጥ፤ ከበሰለ እንቁላል እና ከቀዘቀዘ ለስላሳ አይብ ጋር።

foods.name: Effoi Desta Siga Pizza
foods.amharic_name: እፎይ ደስታ ፒዛ (የበሬ ስጋ፣ ሮዝመሪና ሞዛሬላ)
foods.description: በድንጋይ ምድጃ የበሰለ ቀጭን ሊጥ፣ የተጠበሰ የበሬ ስጋ ቁርጥራጮች፣ ሮዝመሪ፣ ቃሪያ እና የቀለጠ የሞዛሬላ ቺዝ።

foods.name: Moyos Double Smashed Beef Burger
foods.description: ሁለት ጭማቂ የበዛባቸው 100% የበሬ ስጋዎች፣ የቀለጠ ቼዳር ቺዝ፣ ካራመላይዝድ ሽንኩርት እና የሞዮስ ልዩ ሶስ ከትኩስ ቺፕስ ጋር።

foods.name: Castelli Baked Lasagna al Forno
foods.amharic_name: ካስቴሊ ባህላዊ የላዛኛ ፓስታ በስጋና ቺዝ
foods.description: በካስቴሊ ታሪካዊ የምግብ አሰራር የተዘጋጀ ባለብዙ ድርብ የላዛኛ ፓስታ በቀይ የስጋ ሶስ እና በበዛ ሞዛሬላ ቺዝ የተጋገረ።

foods.name: Special Roasted Lamb Mandi on Basmati
foods.description: ለረጅም ሰዓታት በከሰል ምድጃ በዝግታ የበሰለ ለስላሳ የበግ ስጋ፣ በቅመማ ቅመም በተከሸነ ረጅም የባስማቲ ሩዝ እና በሳሃዊቅ ሶስ።

foods.name: Pure 100% Teff Fresh Injera (Pack of 10)
foods.amharic_name: ትኩስ የሰንጋ ነጭ ጤፍ እንጀራ (10 ፍሬ)
foods.description: በንጹህ የሰንጋ ጤፍ በባህላዊ ምጣድ የተጋገረ ለስላሳ፣ ዓይናማ እና ትኩስ እንጀራ በጥንቃቄ የታሸገ።
